The following resources are not affiliated with Sherwood School District, however they are provided here for your convenience.

Dental Resources for Portland Metro Area

Medical Teams International (MTI) Dental Hotline

Urgent dental needs only / Solamente Urgencias Dentales

  • Linea Dental (Dental Hotline)
  • English: 503-624-1000 – Fillings and extractions only
  • Español: 503-343-3370

Virginia Garcia Memorial Dental Hotline (in English and Español)

  • Beaverton Dental (503) 718-3675
  • Cornelius: (503) 359-8505
  • Hillsboro: (503) 352-2354
  • McMinnville: (503) 883-4700
  • Newberg: (971) 281-3050

All Saints Episcopal Church Dental Van (with MTI)

(503) 777-3829
Call All Saints for an appointment. Urgent Dental Needs Only/fillings and extractions only.

PCC Dental Clinic Sylvania Campus

(971) 722-4909
Exams, Cleanings, Fillings, X-rays and sealants

Pacific University Dental Hygiene Clinic in Hillsboro

(503) 352-7373 Cleanings and Exams Only

Braces Assistance for Low Income Families

$30 Application Fee
$650 Required Financial Investment
Click here for more information and application process

Immunization Clinics

Please also see our “Immunizations” page for more resources.

For more immunization resources from Washington County, click here.

For more immunization resources from Yamhill County, click here.
